senses.gloss:
1. भिद् भिद्, ii. 7, भिनद्, भिन्द्, Par. Ātm.
 1. To break, Rām. 2, 80, 17; to destroy, Pañc. i. d. 112.
 2. To tear up, Pañc. 230, 16.
 3. To pierce, Rām. 3, 50, 18; pass. to be afflicted, Pañc. i. d. 436.
 4. To divide, Pañc. i. d. 115; to disjoin, Man. 7, 66.
 5. To betray, 7, 50.
 6. Pass. To differ, Śiś. 9, 46.
 7. Pass. To split, Cāṇ. 21 in Berl. Monatsb. 1864, 406. []
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. भिन्न,
 1. Broken, split, cloven, Rājat. 5, 260.
 2. Divide, Rājat. 5, 176.
 3. Disunited, Hit. iv. d. 39 (दान-, on account of gifts).
 4. Distinguished, other, different (दिनस्य पूर्वार्धपरार्धभिन्नछाया, the shade of the day different in the morning and in the afternoon, Pañc. ii. d. 38).
 5. Separated, detached, without (also as former part of comp. adj.), Pañc. i. d. 212; Megh. 82; Bhāṣāp. 133.
 6. Blown, opened.
 7. Performed with great strides, Vikr. d. 80 (भिन्न-गति, adj. Going quickly, cf. गति-भेद).
 8. Neglected, deviated from.
 9. Connected, joined, mixed, Megh. 60. m. A flaw in a jewel. n.
 1. A bit, a portion.
 2. (in arithmetic), A fraction.
 --Comp.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass.
 I. भेद्य.
 --Comp.
 अ-भेद्य, adj. 1. impenetrable, Rām. 6, 79, 65. 2. indestructible. n. a diamond.
 दुर्भ्˚, i. e. दुस्-, adj. difficult to be broken or divided, Hit. i. d. 21, M.M.
 सुची-, 1. to be pierced by a needle. 2. palpable. 3. very dense (viz. darkness), Hit. 98, 22.
 II. भिद्य, m. a river.
 --Caus. भेदय,
 1. To divide, to cleave, Rām. 1, 16, 23.
 2. To perplex, Rām. 1, 64, 7.
 3. To disunite, MBh. 1, 7399.
 4. To remove, to overcome, MBh. 1, 5592.
 --With the prep. अति अति, अतिभिन in नातिभिन्न, Wholly like, Śāk. 27, 18.
 --With अनु अनु, To break afterward, MBh. 2, 2483.
 --With उद् उद्,
 1. To divide, to pierce through, Vedāntas. in Chr. 209, 7.
 2. Pass. To break forth, Daśak. in Chr. 199, 5. उद्भिन्न,
 1. Opened, burst, Ragh. 13, 21.
 2. Budded.
 3. Destroyed, Lass. 64, 1.
 --With प्रोद् प्र-उद्, प्रोद्भिन्न,
 1. [] Breaking forth, Śāk. 128, 18 Chezy.
 2. Standing erect, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 830.
 --With निस् निस्,
 1. To divide, to cleave, Rām. 3, 55, 10; to open, Vikr. d. 41.
 2. To break down, Daśak. in Chr. 201, 1.
 3. To put out (one's eyes), MBh. 3, 10328.
 4. To pierce, Vikr. d. 144; Rām. 2, 35, 4.
 5. To destroy, Hit. ii. d. 21.
 6. To betray, to divulge, Daśak. in Chr. 193, 8. निर्-भिन,
 1. Pierced, Vikr. d. 150.
 2. Undistinguished, equal (rather भिन्न with निस्).
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass. निर्भेद्य,
 1. Not disappointed, Rām. 6, 91, 26.
 2. Without fissures, Kām. Nītis. 11, 66 (rather भेद्य with निस्).
 --With विनिस् वि-निस्, To cleave, MBh. 3, 8551.
 --With प्र प्र, प्रभिन्न,
 1. Pierced, Sund. 2, 20.
 2. Well cut, detached, Johns. Sel. 54, 134; severed. m. A furious elephant (cf. Johns. 1. 1.).
 --With प्रति प्रति,
 1. To disown, Śiś. 9, 58.
 2. To pierce, Draup. 6, 15.
 3. To reproach, Ragh. 19, 22.
 4. To betray, Daśak. in Chr. 190, 22. प्रतिभिन्न,
 1. Pierced.
 2. Separated.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To cleave, Chr. 292, 10 = Rigv. i. 85, 10.
 2. To pierce, MBh. 3, 709. विभिन्न,
 1. Pierced, wounded.
 2. Broken.
 3. Scattered, moved to and fro, Vikr. d. 85.
 4. Mixed, Kir. 5, 34.
 5. Various.
 6. Disappointed.
 7. Bewildered.
 --Caus. To alienate, Rām. 2, 7, 18.
 --With सम् सम्, संभिन्न,
 1. Divided.
 2. Shaken.
 3. Combined, united.
 --Cf. Lat. findo, finis (for fid + nis); Goth. beitan; A.S. bitan (with batan, Caus. to cause to bite, to bait); Goth. baitar; A.S. biter; O.H.G. biz, bizzo, fiza, etc.; ϕείδομαι, ϕιτρός (for ϕιδ + τρος), and probably ϕῑμός (for ϕιδ-μός).

2. भिद् भिद्,
 I. adj. Who or what [] breaks, divides, destroys; cf. बलभिद्.
 II. f.
 1. Difference, kind.
 2. Breaking, dividing.
 --Comp.

भिदक भिद् + अक,
 I. m. A sword.
 II. n. Indra's thunderbolt.

भिदा भिद् + आ, f.
 1. Tearing, cleaving, Kir. 5, 43.
 2. Coriander.
भिदि भिद् + इ, m., भिदिर भिद् + इर, n., भिदु भिद् + उ, m., and भिद्र भिद् + र, n. Indra's thunderbolt.

भिदुर भिद् + उर,
 I. adj. Brittle.
 II. n. Thunderbolt; Pañc. i. d. 241 corr. पिठरु, see my translation.
